units.source_text: 是新布局还是旧布局，是“星位”还是“小目”？

en.t: Would it be a new opening or an old one, a star point or a komoku?

units.source_text: 大竹七段是摆新阵势还是维持旧阵势？

en.t: Would Otake, seventh dan, set up a new formation or maintain the old one?
This drew the attention of the public.

units.source_text: 但是，黑方第一手是在右上角“17·四”，这“小目”是旧布局。

en.t: But Black's first move was at 17-4 in the upper right corner, and this komoku was an old-style opening.

units.source_text: 黑一“小目”，解答了这盘棋的一个大疑问。

en.t: Black's first move, the komoku, answered one of the great questions about this game.
